summary.intent: Fix two CI failures: flaky E2E tests in the web app and a Grafana Cloud provisioning failure in the staging pipeline.
summary.outcome: Fixed the upload dedup race condition in FileList.tsx and verified both originally-failing E2E tests pass locally; Grafana failure identified as a configuration issue (wrong stack URL) requiring manual action. PR raised for the code fix.

repo: The web E2E test suite has a learnings doc at .learnings/2026-03-29-e2e-test-debugging-workflow.md that defines the canonical debugging workflow.
The web dev server proxies /api to localhost:3000 by default; VITE_API_URL must be overridden to point at staging API for local-vs-staging E2E runs.
Web3Auth initialization requires the app origin to be trusted — running the web app on localhost pointed at staging API caused login to fail until the correct .env was in place.
The Grafana provisioning job uses GRAFANA_URL set in the GitHub 'staging' environment; the current value resolves to HTTP 404, indicating the stack URL is wrong or the instance was deprovisioned.
API .env files live in ../cipher-box/apps (the main repo), not in the worktree — they must be copied when working in a parallel worktree.

code.finding: Dedup filter previously removed real file rows when their name matched a completing upload entry (1-second green flash). Fixed by reversing the logic: filter out the upload row when a real file with the same name exists, so the real file is never removed from the DOM during the completion flash.

workflow: For web-only fixes, run the web dev server locally with VITE_API_URL pointed at the staging API, then run Playwright tests against localhost — no local API server needed.
Copying .env files from the main repo into a parallel worktree is the fastest way to unblock local dev server startup.
When a background dev server exits immediately, check for port conflicts (e.g., port 3000 already in use by main repo's API) before investigating other causes.
Reverting .env changes before committing is important — staging API URL should not be committed as the default.

friction: Multiple failed attempts to get the dev server running: initial CORS/auth failure when web pointed at staging without correct .env, port 3000 conflict with main repo API, and background servers silently exiting.

Playwright config auto-starts a local API server which conflicted with the manual local-web-plus-staging-API setup, causing test 17 (session restore after reload) to fail locally even though it passes in CI.
No VITE_API_URL in the worktree's web .env initially — had to grep and manually discover the env var name before overriding it.
Usage limit hit mid-session, causing an interruption before E2E results were confirmed.
open_items: Grafana Cloud provisioning failure is unresolved — requires manually finding the correct stack URL in grafana.com and updating the GRAFANA_URL secret in the GitHub 'staging' environment, plus re-validating the GRAFANA_API_KEY.

full-workflow test 17 ('Page reload preserves session') fails locally when web is pointed at staging API — root cause not fully investigated; may be a pre-existing flake or environment-specific auth session issue.
Consider adding continue-on-error: true to the provision-dashboard CI job to unblock staging deploys while the Grafana instance issue is resolved.
